BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL  ON THE 9 th OF JULY, 2025  CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 4658 of 2025  RITESH MASKOLE  Versus  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND OTHERS  Appearance:
 Shri Sourabh Bhushan Shrivastava - Advocate for the a  Ms. Nupur Dhamija- Dy.G.A. for the State.
 ORDER
This second criminal appeal has been filed under Section 14-A of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.

2.Appellant has been arrested in connection with Crime No.274/2024 registered at Police Station- Rehti District Sehore for the offences punishable under Sections 376-D, 376(2)(N), 366, 506 of IPC and Sections 3(1)(w)(ii) and 3(2)(v) of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.
Appellant is in jail since 16.05.2024.
3.Prosecution story, in brief, is that appellant and co- accused established physical relation with prosecutrix, aged 22 years.
4.Learned counsel for the appellant submits that in the instant case DNA report does not support prosecution story.
Earlier appeal was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file a fresh appeal after recording testimony of prosecutrix.
As of now testimony of prosecutrix has been recorded.
After NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:30411 2 CRA-4658-2025 referring to testimony of prosecutrix, it is urged that it is a case of consensual relationship.
Appellant is in jail since 16.5.2024.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the appellant be released on bail.
5.On the other hand, learned counsel for the State as well as objector have opposed grant of bail.

sentences.text: 6.I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case- diary.
7.Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on the merits of the case, this appeal is allowed.

8.It is directed that present appellant shall be enlarged on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his regular appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of trial.
It is directed that the appellant shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS.
9.Accordingly, this appeal stands allowed and disposed off.
10.Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately to appellant through concerned Jail Superintendent.
Certified Copy as per rules.
